text: This run checked the token-factory page using the hero (the saved copy from 2026-11-15). The audit found three gaps: A4-cta, A2-value, and A3-proof, which means the hero does not yet show clear button action, product value, or proof. The writer tried three angles: Variant A stressed an OpenAI-compatible API, Variant B stressed inference location and security standards, and Variant C stressed a single catalogue key. Jev and Judge 2 passed Variant A because both judges decided it improved on the gaps. Variant B was held for a person after Jev flagged a phrase, while Variant C was a near miss that failed Gate 2.
